""" def generate_html_response(user_content: str) -> str: """ Generates an HTML page by safely embedding user-provided content into a template. Args: user_content (str): The raw user input to be displayed in the page. Returns: str: A complete HTML document with the user content safely escaped. """ # Escape special characters to prevent XSS and injection attacks safe_content = html.escape(user_content, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
